==Overview==
'''Section UI''' is a section only found in the <span style= "color:#00FF59">Super Epic Mode</span> modifier in the game. featuring a single unique room. Upon opening Room 400, The rooms will start to Spawn with the lights off, and after reaching room 450, the rooms will be replaced by the [[Section I]] Rooms, and at door 500, [[Gato|<span style="text-shadow: 0 0 5px #FFFA00; color: #000000;">Gato</span>]] will spawn, killing the player.

==Strategies==
* It is Recommended that you hide immediately after the music intensifies, and wait for all entities to despawn
** this will be necessary past door 269, as [[UI-269]] gives no warning
* After door 430, you will need to keep your ears open, as [[E-30#Section_UI|<span style="text-shadow: 0 0 5px #FFFF59; color: #FFFF59;">I-30</span>]] will be able to spawn.
* If [[M-60#Section_UI|<span style="text-shadow: 0 0 5px green; color: lime;">I-60</span>]] spawns, you should hide in a previous to prevent your locker from being checked at all
** you should only hide in the current room as a last resort, as [[M-60#Section_UI|<span style="text-shadow: 0 0 5px green; color: lime;">I-60</span>]] will check a random locker in the current room.
* [[Claustrophobia]] takes minutes to attack while in the first 400 rooms, so do not exit hiding untill everything despawns
